import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. # The placeholders {title} and {body} will be replaced by the user supplied values. BLOG_FORMAT = """ {title}

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Formats a user‑submitted blog post into safe HTML. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. content : str The full text body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A fully rendered HTML string with user input properly escaped to prevent XSS attacks (CWE‑79). Raises ------ TypeError If either `headline` or `content` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("content must be a string") # Escape user input to neutralize any malicious scripts. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Construct the final HTML page. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
